Guide recommends one content clause; scanner overwrites earlier content clause with last. Repeated ext clauses accumulate semicolon-separated values, while separate extension input splits commas and intersects inline filter. This matches guide single-clause/intersection caveats.

Guide content case-insensitive claim uses C++ towlower code-unit transformation for matching; Rust preview Unicode to_lowercase has different semantics and confirmed offset issue(v3). Full Unicode/casefold parity not established.
Guide performance examples are qualitative advice, not benchmark results. Entire-content IO and shared index-lock duration remain unmeasured.
